summary: Brookfield Corporation filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report, equivalent to a US current report on Form 8-K) along with a press release dated September 14, 2026, announcing its 2026 Investor Day to be held September 17, 2026 in New York. Brookfield Asset Management will present from 12:45–2:45 p.m. ET, followed by Brookfield Corporation from 3:00–5:00 p.m. ET. The filing contains no transaction terms, no board recommendation, no advisor, and no special-situation mechanics. This is a routine investor-relations scheduling notice with a live webcast and replay, offering no risk-arb angle or watch items beyond the event presentations themselves.
